entries.conditions: accepted and silently miscomputed: a rank-3 pad on a NON-FINAL axis returns the tensor shifted by one along that axis, bit-exact (head h receives head h-1, head 0 zeros). Flavor matrix: rank-3 final-axis front and back pads are correct, rank-4 axis-2 trailing is correct, rank-3 middle-axis and leading-axis trailing both shift. Independent of fp16/fp32

entries.conditions: delegate builder refuses at engine creation with 'RESHAPE: Tensor dimensions must be less than 5' (per-op rejection dump), the fully-delegated hint then fails and LiteRT-LM engine creation aborts. Hit by transformers' repeat_interleave(r, dim=2) on rank-4 q/k (grouped value heads, ratio > 1), which lowers to unsqueeze->expand->rank-5 reshape; ratio-1 configs never trace that branch, so smaller checkpoints of the same family hide the wall (Qwen3.5-0.8B clean, 4B refused)

evidence.source_model: Qwen3.5-4B int8 (GatedDeltaNet hybrid; 32 value heads / 16 key heads)
